The maximum design operating pressure for piping systems located inside buildings shall not exceed 1/2 pounds per square inch gauge (psig) (3.5 kPa gauge).
   Exceptions:
      1.   Pressure not exceeding 5 psig (34.5 kPa gauge) is permitted where a system supplies one or more appliances that require gas pressure in excess of 1/2 psig (3.5 kPa gauge).
      2.   Gas pressure not exceeding 15 psig (103.4 kPa gauge) is permitted for appliances in excess of 100,000 cubic feet per hour (2830 m 3 /h) provided the gas distribution piping is installed as provided for in Section 404.
      3.   The use of pressure in excess of 15 psig (103.4 kPa gauge) shall be permitted for distribution piping provided all of the requirements of Section 406 and Appendix G are met.
